notes.enhancement: Regular polish and gel polish are priced the same for artificial nails.
notes.kids: For children under 9. Regular polish can smudge or mix during kids' activities, so it has no warranty: please check your child's nails before leaving to make sure the color looks right. Thanks for understanding!

policy.title: For our clients and our salon
items: Please let us know about any health concerns, including diabetes, before your service.
Prices are on our menu. Please confirm them with your nail tech before receiving services.
Please give us advance notice if you need to cancel your appointment.
Ask for the service you would like. If you need clarification, please talk to the salon manager.
We do not provide refunds on services, but we will resolve any issue with the service itself.
If you are unsatisfied with our service, please inform the salon manager.
We are not responsible for lost or stolen personal items or gift cards, or for damage to belongings.
We reserve the right to refuse or stop service for anyone who is rude.
policy.thanks: We want to thank you for your continued patronage! It is our pleasure to serve you.

faq.title: Good to know before your visit
faq.intro: Can’t find your answer? Call us at (919) 366-6435 or send us a message on social media.

items.a: Envy Nails Spa Of Wendell offers manicures, signature pedicures, nail enhancements (acrylic, powder gel, builder gel, Gel-X, BIAB), dipping powder, polish changes, custom nail art, waxing and a kids’ menu, in a relaxing and luxurious setting.

items.q: How do I book an appointment?
items.a: Book online any time on our booking page, or message us on social media. Call us directly at (919) 366-6435 if you need appointments for 3 or more people, can’t find your preferred time online, want your favorite nail tech or have special requests.
Yes, appointments and walk-ins are both welcome. Booking ahead guarantees your preferred time.
We’re at 2241 Treelight Way, Suite 102, Wendell, NC 27591. Search “nail salon Treelight Way” or “nail salon Wendell” on Google Maps to find us.
Monday to Thursday 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM, Friday 9:30 AM – 7:00 PM, Saturday 9:30 AM – 6:00 PM and Sunday 11:30 AM – 5:00 PM.
Yes. Our kids’ menu (under 9) has manicures, pedicures, combos and polish changes, in regular or gel polish.
Yes, in any amount at the front desk: a perfect gift for birthdays, holidays and thank-yous.

items.q: Is there anything I should tell my nail tech?
items.a: Please let us know about any health concerns, including diabetes, before your service, and confirm the price of your service with your nail tech.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How Envy Nails Spa of Wendell collects, uses, shares and protects your personal information, and your choices about it.
privacy.intro: At {name}, we are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring the security of your personal information. This Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, and safeguard the information you provide when using our website, online booking and salon services.

sections.title: Information We Collect
paragraphs: Personal information: when you book an appointment or contact {name}, we may collect personal information that you voluntarily provide, such as your name, email address, phone number, and any other information you choose to share with us.
Usage information: we may also collect non-personal information about your use of our services, including device information, usage data, and analytical information.

sections.title: Use of Collected Information
paragraphs: We may use the personal information you provide to us for the following purposes:
items: To provide you with our services, including booking and managing your appointments at {name}.
To communicate with you and respond to your inquiries, feedback, or support requests.
To personalize your experience and improve our services.
To send you important updates, notifications, and marketing communications related to {name}, only if you have opted in to receive such communications.

sections.title: Data Security
paragraphs: We take appropriate measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or destruction. We use industry-standard security technologies and procedures to safeguard your data.

sections.title: Data Retention
paragraphs: We will retain your personal information for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this Privacy Policy, unless a longer retention period is required or permitted by law.

sections.title: Third-Party Services
paragraphs: {name} may integrate with third-party services or include links to external websites or applications. This Privacy Policy does not cover the privacy practices of these third parties. We encourage you to review the privacy policies of any third-party services or websites you interact with.

On this website, the map is provided by Google Maps, videos in some articles by YouTube (only a thumbnail shows until you press play; the player then loads from youtube-nocookie.com), and online booking opens a page run by our booking provider: their own privacy policies apply there.

sections.title: Children's Privacy
paragraphs: Our online services are not intended for use by individuals under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe we have inadvertently collected personal information from a child, please contact us immediately.

sections.title: Changes to this Privacy Policy
paragraphs: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be effective when we post the revised Privacy Policy on this website. We encourage you to review this Privacy Policy periodically.

sections.title: Your Choices
items: Access and correction: you may request access to and correction of your personal information.
Opt-out: you may opt out of receiving marketing communications from us by following the unsubscribe instructions provided in those communications.
Cookies: you can manage your cookie preferences through your browser settings. However, disabling cookies may affect your experience on our website.

sections.title: Sharing Policy
paragraphs: All the above categories exclude text messaging opt-in data and consent; this information will not be shared with third parties.

SMS opt-in sharing policy: we will not share your SMS opt-in data with third parties for purposes unrelated to providing services. Your SMS opt-in status may be shared only with third parties that help us deliver messages, such as platform providers, phone companies, and messaging vendors.

sections.title: Contact Us
paragraphs: If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please call us at {phone} or visit us at {address}.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.description: The terms for booking, salon communications and the SMS programs of Envy Nails Spa of Wendell.
terms.intro: Welcome to {name}. These Terms of Service govern your use of our services, including appointment booking, salon communications, and related point-of-sale (POS) services.

sections.title: Introduction
paragraphs: By using our services, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the applicable services.

sections.title: Appointment Booking and Service Communications
paragraphs: {name} may use the contact information you provide to manage appointments, communicate appointment changes, respond to inquiries, and provide information related to services you request.
You are responsible for providing accurate contact information and notifying us if your contact information changes.

sections.title: SMS Programs
paragraphs: {name} offers optional SMS messaging programs, which may include:
items: Transactional messages: appointment confirmations, appointment reminders, appointment changes, and notifications related to POS services or other transactions.
Marketing messages: promotions, special offers, discounts, and other marketing communications.

sections.title: Consent to Receive Messages
paragraphs: By providing your phone number and selecting the applicable SMS consent checkbox, you agree to receive the corresponding category of text messages from {name}.

Marketing SMS consent and transactional SMS consent are separate and optional. You may consent to one category without consenting to the other. Consent to receive marketing messages is not a condition of purchase.

sections.title: Message Frequency and Rates
paragraphs: Message frequency may vary depending on your appointments, transactions, and communication preferences. Message and data rates may apply according to your wireless carrier and mobile plan.

sections.title: Opt-Out Instructions
paragraphs: You may opt out of SMS messages at any time by replying STOP to a message. After opting out, you may receive a confirmation of your request, and we will stop sending the applicable category of messages, except where otherwise permitted by law.
For assistance, reply HELP or call {name} at {phone}.

sections.title: Participating Carriers
paragraphs: Wireless carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages. Message delivery may depend on your wireless carrier, network availability, and other factors outside our control.

sections.title: Privacy of SMS Information
paragraphs: SMS consent records and opt-in information will not be sold or shared with third parties for their own marketing purposes. Such information may be shared with service providers, messaging platforms, and wireless carriers as necessary to deliver messages and operate our services. For more information, please review our Privacy Policy.

sections.title: Privacy Policy
paragraphs: Your use of our services is also subject to our Privacy Policy, which explains how we collect, use, retain, and protect personal information.

sections.title: Acceptable Use
paragraphs: You agree to provide accurate information when using our services and not to misuse our booking systems, communication channels, or other services. We may take reasonable measures to protect our systems and prevent fraud, abuse, or unauthorized activity.

sections.title: Service Availability
paragraphs: We make reasonable efforts to maintain the availability of our booking and communication services. However, services may occasionally be unavailable because of maintenance, technical issues, carrier interruptions, or other circumstances beyond our control.

sections.title: Limitation of Liability
paragraphs: To the extent permitted by applicable law, {name} is not responsible for delays or failures in SMS delivery caused by wireless carriers, network outages, or other third-party systems beyond our reasonable control.
Nothing in these Terms excludes or limits any rights or remedies that cannot legally be excluded or limited.

sections.title: Changes to These Terms
paragraphs: We may update these Terms of Service from time to time. Updated terms will be posted on this website with a revised effective date. Your continued use of our services after an update constitutes acceptance of the revised terms to the extent permitted by applicable law.

sections.title: Contact Us
paragraphs: If you have questions about these Terms of Service or our SMS messaging programs, please call {name} at {phone} or visit us at {address}.
